title: LiDAR Intensity Reconstruction with Limited Real Data: An Architecture Benchmark under Fixed-Epoch Training
abstract: arXiv:2611.34724v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Physics-derived simulation can supplement scarce real-world LiDAR intensity measurements, but its effectiveness depends on the learning architecture and the amount of real training data available. We benchmark nine neural architectures for LiDAR intensity reconstruction from depth, semantic labels, incidence angle, and material reflectance, using real SemanticKITTI and synthetic VoxelScape range-image data. All models follow a fixed 20-epoch protocol; this controls the number of training passes, not the computational cost across architectures. We report mean absolute error (MAE), mean squared error (MSE), peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR), structural similarity (SSIM), inference timing, and spectral-energy agreement. We also evaluate four selected architectures with fixed-size training mixtures containing 0\%, 1\%, 5\%, 10\%, 20\%, 50\%, or 100\% real frames. translated_title: 有限真实数据下的激光雷达强度重建：固定轮次训练下的架构基准测试
translated_abstract: 基于物理推导的仿真可以补充稀缺的真实世界激光雷达强度测量数据，但其有效性取决于学习架构以及可用的真实训练数据量。我们针对从深度、语义标签、入射角和材料反射率重建激光雷达强度这一任务，对九种神经架构进行了基准测试，使用了真实的SemanticKITTI和合成的VoxelScape距离图像数据。所有模型均遵循固定的20轮（epoch）训练协议；该协议控制的是训练轮数，而非各架构之间的计算成本。我们报告了平均绝对误差（MAE）、均方误差（MSE）、峰值信噪比（PSNR）、结构相似性（SSIM）、推理耗时以及频谱能量一致性。此外，我们使用包含0%、1%、5%、10%、20%、50%或100%真实帧的固定规模训练混合数据，对四种选定的架构进行了评估。在仅使用真实数据训练的情况下，UNet-V2取得了已报告结果中最优的重建性能。
tldr: 该论文在固定20轮训练协议下，对九种神经架构在真实数据稀缺、以物理仿真数据补充的激光雷达强度重建任务上进行了系统基准测试，发现UNet-V2在纯真实数据训练下表现最佳，并量化了不同真实数据比例对重建性能的影响。
en_tdlr: This paper benchmarks nine neural architectures for LiDAR intensity reconstruction under a fixed 20-epoch protocol with physics-derived simulation supplementing scarce real data, showing that UNet-V2 achieves the best performance with real-only training and quantifying how different proportions of real frames affect reconstruction quality.
